name: Bartoszyce (Poland)
description: Black field with a white stripe along the top and a white axe at the centre, after the Teutonic banner of Bartoszyce described in Jan Długosz's Banderia Prutenorum.
history: The flag follows the Teutonic banner of Bartoszyce described by Jan Długosz in the Banderia Prutenorum; its proportions range from 2:3 to 5:8.

features.role: axe from the Teutonic banner of Bartoszyce
